channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Outdoor work to halt under red alerts as OHSA proposes binding storm safety rules
item.description: Employers would be legally required to stop dangerous outdoor activities, secure worksites and activate emergency plans when extreme weather warnings are issued

item.title: Teatru Manoel presents Verdi’s Falstaff
item.description: Teatru Manoel, in collaboration with the Malta National Opera, will present Falstaff, Giuseppe Verdi’s comic opera, between 22 February and 1 March as part of the theatre’s 2025/2026 artistic programme

item.title: Two arraigned over Għargħur violent robbery and assault
item.description: Both accused pleaded guilty to the charges brought against them

item.title: Court hands suspended sentence to teen involved in Paceville stabbing incident
item.description: 17-year-old youth handed suspended prison sentence after admitting to his involvement in a violent incident in Paceville which left three British nationals injured

item.title: 140 complaints, but no fines issued over cannabis smell nuisance
item.description: ARUC study with University of Malta revealed traces of pesticides were found on illegal cannabis, but not on legally sourced marijuana

item.title: AUM moves to remove boats from its private water space in Bormla
item.description: The situation originates from a 2015 agreement which granted the American University of Malta extensive rights over the shoreline and the airspace above it

item.title: Man behind alleged theft of luxury cars gets bail
item.description: Court hears how man allegedly stole an Audi S7, a Rolls-Royce Ghost and a Bentley Continental

item.title: Elderly man grievously hurt after getting hit by pick-up truck
item.description: Preliminary investigations suggest that the elderly man was hit by an Isuzu pick-up truck driven by a 38-year-old Mosta resident

item.title: PM and Opposition leader have ‘healthy discussion’ on new chief justice, talks to continue
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela and Opposition leader Alex Borg hold what they describe as a positive discussion on the appointment of a new chief justice

item.title: Clearer youth information, stronger participation | Keith Azzopardi Tanti
item.description: Young people don’t need more explaining. They need more ownership. And when we give them that, the quality of our public conversation improves for everyone
